result.question: Quais procedimentos, ordenados por volume decrescente, cobrem até 80% do total de atendimentos realizados?
result.gold_sql: SELECT nome_proc FROM (SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS nome_proc, COUNT(*) AS total_atendimentos, ROUND(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_acumulado FROM atendimentos a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC") sub WHERE pct_acumulado <= 80 ORDER BY total_atendimentos DESC;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_atendimentos AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM atendimentos ), procedimentos_count AS ( SELECT p."NOME_PROC", COUNT(*) AS total FROM atendimentos a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ), ranked_procedures AS ( SELECT pc."NOME_PROC", pc.total, SUM(pc.total) OVER (ORDER BY pc.total DESC) AS cumulative_total FROM procedimentos_count pc ) SELECT rp."NOME_PROC" FROM ranked_procedures rp WHERE rp.cumulative_total <= (SELECT total * 0.8 FROM total_atendimentos) ORDER BY rp.total DESC;
